title: Josiah Keeps the Passover

questions.question: When did they kill the Passover lamb?
options: On the fourteenth day of the first month
questions.correctAnswer: On the fourteenth day of the first month
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 35:1 (ESV): "...and they slaughter the Passover lamb on the fourteenth day of the first month."

questions.question: What did Josiah contribute to the people for the Passover offerings?
options: 30,000 lambs and young goats and 3,000 bulls
questions.correctAnswer: 30,000 lambs and young goats and 3,000 bulls

questions.question: Was there ever a Passover like this kept in Israel?
options: No Passover like it had been kept in Israel since the days of Samuel the prophet
questions.correctAnswer: No Passover like it had been kept in Israel since the days of Samuel the prophet
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 35:18 (ESV): "No Passover like it had been kept in Israel since the days of Samuel the prophet."

questions.question: Who came up to fight at Carchemish on the Euphrates?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 35:20 (ESV): "...Neco king of Egypt went up to fight at Carchemish..."

questions.question: What did Neco tell Josiah?
options: What have we to do with each other? I am not coming against you... God has commanded me to hurry
questions.correctAnswer: What have we to do with each other? I am not coming against you... God has commanded me to hurry
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 35:21 (ESV): "...What have we to do with each other... I am not coming against you this day, but against the house with which I am at war. And God has commanded me to hurry..."

questions.question: Did Josiah listen to Neco?
options: No, he would not turn away from him, but disguised himself and fought
He sent his army but stayed back
questions.correctAnswer: No, he would not turn away from him, but disguised himself and fought
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 35:22 (ESV): "Nevertheless, Josiah would not turn away from him, but disguised himself in order to fight with him..."

questions.question: How was Josiah killed?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 35:23 (ESV): "And the archers shot King Josiah..."

questions.question: To where did they bring the wounded Josiah?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 35:24 (ESV): "...and brought him to Jerusalem. And he died..."

questions.question: Who uttered a lament for Josiah?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 35:25 (ESV): "Jeremiah also uttered a lament for Josiah..."

questions.question: What became a custom in Israel regarding Josiah?
options: All the singing men and singing women speak of Josiah in their laments to this day
questions.correctAnswer: All the singing men and singing women speak of Josiah in their laments to this day
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 35:25 (ESV): "...and all the singing men and singing women speak of Josiah in their laments to this day..."

questions.question: How did they roast the Passover lamb?
options: With fire according to the rule
questions.correctAnswer: With fire according to the rule
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 35:13 (ESV): "And they roasted the Passover lamb with fire according to the rule..."

questions.question: Why were the priests busy until night?
options: Offering the burnt offerings and the fat parts
questions.correctAnswer: Offering the burnt offerings and the fat parts
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 35:14 (ESV): "...because the priests, the sons of Aaron, were busy offering the burnt offerings and the fat parts until night..."

questions.question: Who were the rulers of the house of God mentioned?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 35:8 (ESV): "...Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, the chief officers of the house of God..."

questions.question: In which year of Josiah was this Passover kept?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 35:19 (ESV): "In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah this Passover was kept."

questions.question: Whose words were Neco's words?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 35:22 (ESV): "...He did not listen to the words of Neco from the mouth of God..."

key_verse_text: Jeremiah also uttered a lament for Josiah; and all the singing men and singing women speak of Josiah in their laments to this day. They made these a rule in Israel; behold, they are written in the Laments.
